| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | `string` | no | Only disputes with this status. |
| `open` | `boolean` | no | `true`: only disputes still awaiting a decision (`needs_response`, `under_review`). |
| `sort` | `string` | no | `created` (default, newest first) or `evidence_due_by` (soonest evidence deadline first; none last). |

| `payment` | `string` | no | Only the disputes on this payment (`pay_…`). An unknown payment gives an empty list. |

|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
